findings.title: Sanction review date passed
findings.condition: Review/expiry date 2026-08-31; 30 days before audit date.
findings.requested_evidence: Obtain renewal approval, latest sanction and bank-policy assessment.

findings.title: Stock statement exceeds review-age setting
findings.condition: Statement age 122 days; configured screen 90. Recalculation uses this historical statement only.
findings.evidence_refs: accounts:CC002 (Fictional sanction/account extract CC002); stocks:ST02 (Fictional stock/debtor certificate ST02)
findings.requested_evidence: Obtain current stock/debtor statement, ageing and applicable bank policy.

findings.title: Bank DP differs from recomputed capped DP
findings.condition: Bank DP 900000; recomputed capped DP 705000.00; bank less audit 195000.00. Method: Before margin.
findings.evidence_refs: accounts:CC002 (Fictional sanction/account extract CC002); stocks:ST02 (Fictional stock/debtor certificate ST02)
findings.requested_evidence: Verify eligibility exclusions, receivable ageing, unpaid stock treatment, margins and bank sanction methodology.
findings.evidence_assessment: Fictional account/sanction source and ST02 support the reported calculation inputs; actual documents are not authenticated.
findings.management_response: Fictional branch response: current DP working and renewal evidence will be supplied.
findings.auditor_conclusion: Bank DP 900000 differs from selected-method historical DP 705000. A 122-day-old statement prevents a current eligibility conclusion.
findings.recommended_action: Obtain current statements, debtor ageing, and the sanction methodology; reperform before final reporting.
findings.proposed_reporting_point: Reconcile DP to sanctioned creditor/margin methodology and current statements; branch evidence pending.

findings.title: Snapshot exceeds recalculated availability
findings.condition: Outstanding 850000; available min(sanction, recomputed DP) 705000.00; snapshot excess 145000.00. This is not a continuous-period conclusion.
findings.evidence_refs: accounts:CC002 (Fictional sanction/account extract CC002); stocks:ST02 (Fictional stock/debtor certificate ST02)
findings.requested_evidence: Check current statement, permitted exceptions and daily effective limits.

findings.title: Continuous excess screen triggered
findings.condition: Closing balance exceeded lower of daily sanction/DP on all 90 supplied days. Review applicable IRAC rules; no automatic NPA conclusion.
findings.requested_evidence: Verify complete effective-limit history, permitted exceptions and borrower-level classification.

findings.title: Outstanding exceeds snapshot sanction
findings.requested_evidence: Review approved temporary limits, effective dates and sanction conditions.

findings.title: Daily conduct history incomplete
findings.condition: 30/90 dates supplied; full-window screen unavailable. Account opened 2020-01-01.
findings.requested_evidence: Obtain complete day-end balances, daily effective sanction/DP, credits and interest; include non-business dates.

findings.title: Charge registration requires document review
findings.condition: No available in-date record under supplied checklist. Supplied: DOC-CC004-4 status Missing, valid_until None, Fictional register assertion; document not authenticated.
findings.requested_evidence: Obtain/inspect Charge registration and assess applicability, validity and sanctioned conditions. Checklist is illustrative, not a universal legal requirement.

findings.title: No credits over complete screening window
findings.condition: Zero reported credits during 90 dates. Zero credits with nil interest/balance may have a different explanation.
findings.requested_evidence: Inspect account conduct, credit provenance and applicable classification criteria.

findings.title: Window credits below interest debits
findings.requested_evidence: Review transaction-level receipts, interest, effective window and applicable IRAC treatment.

findings.title: Unpaid scheduled dues exceed review-day setting
findings.condition: Oldest unpaid due 2026-06-30: 92 days; unpaid scheduled amount 110000. Allocations are user supplied, not reconstructed from receipts.
findings.requested_evidence: Verify contractual due dates, receipt appropriation, concessions and applicable classification criteria.

findings.title: Scheduled dues unpaid at audit date
findings.condition: Oldest unpaid due 15 days; unpaid scheduled amount 22000.
findings.requested_evidence: Confirm due-date/end-of-day status and receipt allocation. Screen does not assign SMA/NPA.
